I build end-to-end analytical solutions that turn complex biomedical data into reliable, actionable insights. Across my roles, I have focused on solving difficult problems in translational genomics, clinical analytics, and scalable data workflows—often combining statistical modeling, workflow engineering, and domain expertise to improve decision quality and operational efficiency.

Below is a concise summary of the outcomes and impact from my recent roles.


# Precision Scientific · 2021–2024

**R&D | Middle bioinformatics engineer**

## Cancer auxiliary diagnosis enablement
`2022-2024`

<ul class="horizontal-list">
    <li class="horizontal-list__item horizontal-list__item--imperial-blue">MRD</li>
    <li class="horizontal-list__item horizontal-list__item--dark-orange">HRD</li>
    <li class="horizontal-list__item horizontal-list__item--lavender">WGD</li>
    <li class="horizontal-list__item horizontal-list__item--grape">ML</li>
    <li class="horizontal-list__item horizontal-list__item--pink">Pipeline</li>

</ul>

- Designed and productionized circulating tumor DNA–based Minimal Residule Diesase (MRD) pipelines (study design → feature engineering → data analysis → statistical reporting).
- Delivered 4 clinical MRD studies and translated results into regulatory-ready reports; one outcome presented at SGO 2024; co-authored 2 manuscripts (one published).
- Analyzed whole-genome doubling (WGD) using low-pass whole genome sequencing (WGS) in ~1× coverage; standardized WGD definitions across four studies.
- Built machine learning classifiers using platelet RNA-seq data to differentiate uterine sarcoma vs. leiomyoma; conducted end-to-end analysis workflow (RNA-seq preprocessing → feature engineering → model evaluation → biomarker detection).
- Contributed to the national HRD reference standard project led by China’s National Institutes for Food and Drug Control.
